result.scope: adaptive exposed-DEV capacity comparison; no new storage advantage, independent confirmation, official benchmark score or novel architecture claim

scope:
Same previously exposed DEV2, with one pooled rate selected per family from both rates and all three seeds.
Accuracy dots retain every selected seed; diamonds are mean individual RMSEs, not ensemble forecasts.
Six R12 fits are new; all36 R4/dense/GRU/legacy fits and frozen references are copied without refitting.
128-step (12.8 s) offline forecasts are conditional on realized measured torque, not verified issued commands.
Structured models initialize from the last two observed positions; GRU conditions on the supplied prefix.
All selected-model latency probes are current-host full requests. CONFIRM and official TEST remain closed.
No new storage advantage, architectural novelty, robot-safety, native speedup or official benchmark claim.

selection.scope: same exposed DEV2; three seeds per rate; all36 parent fits reselected without refitting
